type ErrorEntry = { message: string, trace: string, script: string, count: number, ctx: number, log: number }

local errors: { ErrorEntry } = {}
local errorIndex: { [string]: ErrorEntry } = {}
local warnings: { string } = {}
local warningCounts: { [string]: number } = {}
local droppedErrors, droppedWarnings = 0, 0
local joins = 0

local function clip(s: any, n: number): string
	local str = tostring(s or "")
	if #str > n then
		return string.sub(str, 1, n) .. "..."
	end
	return str
end

-- A script error usually arrives twice: ScriptContext.Error (with trace/script) and LogService
-- (MessageError). Count each source separately and report the max, so one error counts once.
local function addError(fromCtx: boolean, message: string, trace: string?, scriptName: string?)
	local msg = clip(message, MAX_MSG)
	local e = errorIndex[msg]
	if not e then
		if #errors >= MAX_ITEMS then
			droppedErrors += 1
			return
		end
		e = { message = msg, trace = "", script = "", count = 0, ctx = 0, log = 0 }
		errorIndex[msg] = e
		table.insert(errors, e)
	end
	if fromCtx then
		e.ctx += 1
	else
		e.log += 1
	end
	e.count = math.max(e.ctx, e.log)
	if e.trace == "" and trace and trace ~= "" then
		e.trace = clip(trace, MAX_TRACE)
	end
	if e.script == "" and scriptName and scriptName ~= "" then
		e.script = scriptName
	end
end

local function addWarning(message: string)
	local msg = clip(message, MAX_MSG)
	local c = warningCounts[msg]
	if c then
		warningCounts[msg] = c + 1
		return
	end
	if #warnings >= MAX_ITEMS then
		droppedWarnings += 1
		return
	end
	warningCounts[msg] = 1
	table.insert(warnings, msg)
end

local function onMessage(message: string, messageType: Enum.MessageType)
	if messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageError then
		addError(false, message, nil, nil)
	elseif messageType == Enum.MessageType.MessageWarning then
		addWarning(message)
	end
end

ScriptContext.Error:Connect(function(message: string, trace: string, scr: Instance?)
	local name = ""
	if scr then
		local ok, full = pcall(function()
			return scr:GetFullName()
		end)
		name = if ok then full else tostring(scr)
	end
	addError(true, message, trace, name)
end)

LogService.MessageOut:Connect(onMessage)

-- messages logged before this script started (e.g. errors while other scripts were loading)
pcall(function()
	for _, entry in LogService:GetLogHistory() do
		if entry.timestamp >= startEpoch then

		end
	end
end)

-- Calls the first function found under any of the given names.
-- If none of the names exist on a (table) module, logs once so a broken hookup is visible.
local missingLogged: { [string]: boolean } = {}
local function callFirst(module: any, names: { string }, ...: any): (boolean, any)
	if type(module) ~= "table" then
		return false, nil
	end
	for _, name in names do
		local fn = module[name]
		if type(fn) == "function" then
			local ok, result = pcall(fn, ...)
			if not ok then
				warn(name .. " failed: " .. tostring(result))
			end
			return ok, result
		end
	end
	local key = table.concat(names, "/")
	if not missingLogged[key] then
		missingLogged[key] = true
		if module == UpgradeService and names[1] == "onPlotClaimed" then
			warn("[Forge] UpgradeService has no method: " .. key .. " (purchase pads will not be wired)")

	end
	return false, nil

-- ForgeTelemetry: tiny counter API for generated games. ForgeProbe reports these counters.
--
--   local ForgeTelemetry = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").ForgeTelemetry)
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("coins_collected")      -- +1
--   ForgeTelemetry.count("damage_dealt", 25)     -- +25
--   ForgeTelemetry.get()                          -- { coins_collected = 1, damage_dealt = 25 }
--
-- Counters live as number attributes on ServerStorage.ForgeCounters (a Folder), so every VM in the
-- server (game scripts, ForgeProbe, execute_luau) sees the same values. Server only: on the client
-- count() is a no-op and get() returns {}.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local FOLDER_NAME = "ForgeCounters"

local ForgeTelemetry = {}

local function folder(): Instance?
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return nil
	end
	local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
	local f = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		f = Instance.new("Folder")
		f.Name = FOLDER_NAME
		f.Parent = ServerStorage
	end
	return f
end

-- Attribute names: letters, digits and underscores, max 100 chars, may not start with "RBX".
local function key(name: string): string
	local k = string.gsub(tostring(name), "[^%w_]", "_")
	if k == "" then
		k = "_"
	end
	if string.sub(k, 1, 3) == "RBX" then
		k = "_" .. k
	end
	return string.sub(k, 1, 100)
end

function ForgeTelemetry.count(name: string, n: number?)
	local f = folder()
	if not f then
		return
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		local k = key(name)
		local cur = f:GetAttribute(k)
		local add = tonumber(n) or 1
		f:SetAttribute(k, (if type(cur) == "number" then cur else 0) + add)
	end)
	if not ok then
		-- telemetry must never break the game
		return
	end
end

function ForgeTelemetry.get(): { [string]: number }
	local out: { [string]: number } = {}
	if not RunService:IsServer() then
		return out
	end
	local f = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not f then
		return out
	end
	for k, v in f:GetAttributes() do
		if type(v) == "number" then
			out[k] = v
		end
	end
	return out
end

return ForgeTelemetry
